summary: APM feed s059_single is degraded due to tool overload: 31.56 Gbps microburst exceeds 10 Gbps port capacity (316%). All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, one-way, oversize, drops, truncation, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating multiple inputs onto a single 10 Gbps APM port without load balancing. A 1 ms microburst peaked at 31.56 Gbps (3.16x line rate, 316% of capacity), overflowing the egress queue to the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will drop packets indiscriminately during bursts, causing incomplete transaction traces, inaccurate latency/error metrics, and missed performance degradations despite needing both directions but not full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Flow-hash load balancing across 3-4x 10G APM ports (or 40G) absorbs microbursts within aggregate capacity while preserving flow affinity required for APM bidirectional correlation, preventing burst drops.
